body_encoded.description: true if response body is base64 encoded

body_truncated.description: true if response body was truncated

icmp_available.description: ICMP enrichment fields (H2: populated by diagnostic enricher for all DOWN incidents)

icmp_reachable.description: whether host replied to ICMP echo

icmp_rtt_ms.description: round-trip time in ms; null when unreachable

keyword.description: Keyword enrichment fields (populated for keyword monitor incidents only)

response_body.description: Base64 encoded if needed, truncated to 5KB

config.description: JSON configuration specific to channel type

host_id.description: optional link to a monitored host

notification_channel_names.description:
NotificationChannelNames are channel names to attach; resolved to IDs at create time.
Channels must already exist (they hold secrets and are never created here). Used by the
bulk import path; missing name is a validation error.

tags.description: Tag names - will be created if they don't exist

earliest_day.description:
EarliestDay is the first day for which any uptime data exists, in
YYYY-MM-DD UTC. Empty when no data yet.

latest_day.description: LatestDay is the most recent day we can report on (today UTC).

host_id.description: optional link to a monitored host

tags.description: Tag IDs (ULIDs) - must reference existing tags

host_id.description: spec 079: optional link to a monitored host (null when unlinked)

category.description: Category is one of: resource | incident | page.

deep_link.description: DeepLink is the in-app path that opens the item (e.g. /resources/<id>).

id.description: ID is a stable, category-prefixed id: "resource:<id>" | "incident:<id>" | "page:<label>".

label.description: Label is the primary human-readable text (monitor name, incident cause, page name).

meta.description: Meta is short context (e.g. a monitor's target), omitted when empty.
